en.bottlenecks_bullet: **Structural Bottlenecks:** The manual infrastructure provisioning model severely limits the delivery speed of strategic business initiatives.
en.delayed_faults_bullet: **Late Technical Incident Detection:** The lack of correlated observability increases the Mean Time To Resolution (MTTR) for critical system failures.
en.config_drift_bullet: **Configuration Drift Risk:** Manual configuration maintenance impairs the ability to demonstrate real-time regulatory compliance with {reg_frameworks}.

de.top_risks_intro: Top risks prioritized by their direct impact on service resilience and the cost of inaction (ALE):

top_risks_fallbacks.compute: The reactive model in on-premise compute directly risks service continuity and blocks the deployment of the Digital Twin and strategic AI.
top_risks_fallbacks.container: The lack of an enterprise container platform stalls innovation, creates isolated development silos, and multiplies modernization debt.
top_risks_fallbacks.cloud: The manual remediation of Landing Zones prevents verifying compliance in real-time, exposing the business to severe regulatory penalties.
top_risks_fallbacks.automation: Dependence on manual tickets and approvals delays time-to-market by weeks and generates severe provisioning bottlenecks.
top_risks_fallbacks.default: Fragmentation and inconsistency in monitoring systems make it impossible to correlate alerts and predict complex outages.
